title: Pistachio Jamaican Chicken Sandwich
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken sandwich featuring Jamaican and pistachio flavors. Serve warm and enjoy!
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together jerk seasoning, pistachio meal, and flour.
Dredge the chicken breasts in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, toast the buns by placing them on a baking sheet and baking for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading a layer of pistachio slaw on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked chicken breast, and finishing with the top bun.
